title: bug: Unable to add users/group to board access control when using OIDC via Authentik
body:
### Describe the bug

When trying to add a syncd group/user(OIDC) to a boards Access Control the permissions fail to save and causes the page to refresh.
No boardGroupPermission INSERT/UPDATE query ever reaches the database (confirmed via LOG_LEVEL=debug, no write query logged around the save action).

### Steps to reproduce

1. Homarr deployed via docker ghcr.io/homarr-labs/homarr
2. Set up OIDC login (in my case: Authentik with a Plex source as the identity backend)
3. Log into Homarr via OIDC as a user in a synced admin group
4. Navigate to a board → board settings → Access Control → Groups tab
5. Click "Add," select the group, set a permission level (e.g. "View board")
6. Click "Save group permission"
7. The group disappears from the Access Control list instead of persisting
8. Reproduced in both normal and incognito windows

### Impact

This prevents any permissions setup using authentik with a plex source (haven't tested other sources)
Workaround is to downgrade to version 1.74.0 before the introduction of unify manage and board settings into a single save form


### Additional information

Docker Compose:
```
services:
  homarr:
    container_name: homarr
    image: ghcr.io/homarr-labs/homarr:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      SECRET_ENCRYPTION_KEY: ""
      AUTH_SECRET: ""
      DB_URL: "/appdata/db/db.sqlite"
      DB_DIALECT: "sqlite"
      DB_DRIVER: "better-sqlite3"
      AUTH_PROVIDERS: "oidc,credentials"
      AUTH_OIDC_CLIENT_ID: ""
      AUTH_OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET: ""
      AUTH_OIDC_ISSUER: "http://192.168.0.15:9000/application/o/homarr/"
      AUTH_OIDC_CLIENT_NAME: "Authentik"
      AUTH_OIDC_SCOPE_OVERWRITE: "openid email profile groups"
      AUTH_OIDC_GROUPS_ATTRIBUTE: "groups"
    volumes:
      - ./configs:/app/data/configs
      - ./icons:/app/public/icons
      - ./data:/data
    ports:
      - "7575:7575"

```

### Version

1.76.2

### Installation method

Docker Compose

### Browser

Chrome
